summary: Expanded the universe around transmission-line hardware and installation-enabling components. The highest-purity underfollowed candidate is Preformed Line Products, which appears directly tied to fittings, conductor accessories, fiber/OPGW accessories, and line-construction hardware. Hubbell is the reference diversified leader for utility T&D components. Valmont and AZZ are second-order infrastructure enablers: Valmont through transmission and distribution structures, AZZ through galvanizing/coatings and its AVAIL JV exposure to power-transmission infrastructure.
